entries.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: single narrative CG for age-appropriate school romance visual novel. Reference image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY and crisp inked cel-shading STYLE only, not pose/composition. Same teenage girl Choi Hyunsol as reference: straight black chin-length bob with bangs and two silver hairpins, gray eyes, tiny beauty mark near eye, white collared shirt teal necktie and modest dark skirt, white labcoat for lab tasks only and goggles when appropriate. Preserve facial identity and hair, no redesign. Change expression and gesture exactly; do not copy reference pose.
Create ONE 16:9 LANDSCAPE wide illustration, NOT collage, not card, not portrait crop.
Scene: bright school art studio, pigments watercups paper with colorpatches only, labcoat used as protective garment, goggles off.
Composition: very high near-top-down wide shot of art-room worktable with Hyunsol standing off to side, hands and whole gesture visible. Framing and staging must strongly differ from the reference portrait. Environment is substantial and legible.
Expression: tentative bashful smile, head slightly bowed sideways.
Action/gesture: presses two watercolor swatches together into a third hue with a broad brush, other hand raises paint-stained fingertips away from shirt.
Crisp sophisticated anime linework and clean celshading matching reference; natural cinematic lighting, detailed grounded environment, restrained school-life feeling. Ordinary fully clothed teenagers, innocent interaction. If player indicated, show only cropped neutral-clothed shoulder or hand, no additional face. Correct anatomy and hands, exactly two arms. No text, dialogue, captions, UI, logos, watermark, split panels, repeated character, seductive staging, sexualization, foreshortened skirt view. Do not make frontal table-and-offered-hand pose.
